text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Friday:
- Globus Group posted a first-half sales increase of 1.8 percent to 758 million Swiss francs but still expects a high loss for the year.
- Portescap, a micro-technique firm in La Chaux de Fonds plans to merge with U.S. firm American Precision Industries. They have signed a temporary agreement.
- Travel group Kuoni expects good results this year and a net profit of over 60 million Swiss francs.
- Basel-based chemical giant Ciba applied to the Federal Department of Health for a permit to import genetically altered corn.
- Swiss diplomats to important western countries will meet at the end of next week in Berne for a two-day "crisis discussion" on Holocaust survivors assets held in Swiss banks.
- Carpenters in the Italian and German-speaking regions of Switzerland will earn 10 centimes more per hour January 1.
- Swiss Bank Corporation's profit rose by 27 percent in the first nine months of the year, compared to the same period last year.
